name: Maou Kourin ~Onna Yuusha Shojo Ryoujoku~
original_name: 魔王降臨　～女勇者処女凌辱～
source:
Become the fearsome devil king who terrorizes so many kingdoms in popular JRPG games -- only this time you're assaulting them in a conquest-driven ADV + SIM style!

Expand your evil empire across the realm, taking down the 3 main characters of female hero, female mage and female warrior - but also map-wandering mercenaries, elves, shrine maidens and village girl minor characters.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076972.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
成为可怕的魔王，在流行的JRPG游戏中恐吓众多王国 - 只是这一次你是以征服驱动的ADV + SIM风格攻击他们！

将你的邪恶帝国扩展到整个领域，打倒女英雄、女法师和女战士这3位主角，还有地图流浪的雇佣兵、精灵、巫女和乡村女孩小角色。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076972.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
